description: Practice account: $100 of simulated money for the whole Kraken USD market. Plain code closes every position and stops the account when equity reaches $80. No leverage, no shorting, no real money, no broker. Your own trades may use all your cash; the agents' limits live in config/trading-desk.json.

shutdown.note: A trigger, not a guarantee: prices can gap below $80 between checks, and closing costs slippage and fees.
